ETH.note: Directive covers payments to public bodies, not procurement.

facts.fact: Directive 1069/2025 defines payment service providers as those licensed or authorized by the National Bank of Ethiopia to issue payment instruments, and requires federal public bodies to accept payments from all of them.

ETH.note: Consumer protection appears only in a recital, no rule or body stated.
Directive covers payments to government, not to people.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Finance directive names mobile wallets, prepaid payment instruments and mobile and internet banking issued by NBE-licensed providers as instruments all federal public bodies must accept.
facts.system: Mobile wallets and prepaid payment instruments

facts.fact: Directive 1069/2025 requires all federal public bodies, within 90 days, to accept electronic payments of fees, charges, taxes and penalties from licensed providers and to integrate their collection systems with authorised payment gateways, with the Ministry of Finance monitoring.
